question: In the already accepted D04 fixed one-aircraft OPHOURS=3 run, what do the complete event and half-hour report ledgers show during the thirty calendar hours without flight between h10 and h40?

source.interpretation: The manual defines PMINT in OPID and OPHOURS as operation hours; actual counter values are not exposed by this report and any lack-of-accrual wording is an inference from the observed event timing.

predeclared_acceptance: Independent contract GO must precede author replay. Use only the sealed accepted D04 run; do not launch SIMLOX or alter its input, raw files, closure, accepted signoff, or original validation reports.

Verify D04 and D03 source/signoff pins, installed manual/executable pins, D04 invocation/closure identity and all 12 local raw SHA/size seals; require complete accepted parent source hash before/after stability, SSH session0, recorded GUI PID/session/start and mutex provenance.

Parse a copy of the default raw JSON report in memory, retaining its original byte hash. Require 120 contiguous half-hour SystemResults rows and 120 StockTotalResults rows with expected field counts plus the single 11-field ResultSummary row, and zero reported converter errors.

From the complete event log require first mission start h8, success/return h10, second mission order/allocation h39, start h40, success/return h41, and sole PM start h41/completion h42. Require no flight or PM event strictly between h10 and h40; classify the h39-40 reservation distinctly from flight/ready.

For every one of the 58 half-hour bins h10 through h38.5 require ready1, available1, mission0, PM0, PM start/completion0. For both h39 and h39.5 bins require ready0, available1, mission0, PM0, PM markers0. Require h40 and h40.5 flight1/PM0 and h41/41.5 PM1, with counters at h41/h42 and terminal ready state consistent with event ledger.

Independently replay the full ledger and source/raw seals without importing author checker; publish only a bounded read-only observation with explicit absence of direct counter trace, second parking duration, alternative mission schedule, GUI visual and cross-engine evidence. Require separate staged and remote publication review before merge.
limits: This is a catalog mapping of the already accepted D04 run, not a fresh parent-versus-child experiment or additional native run.
One 30-hour no-flight gap in one seed, one aircraft and one fixed mission schedule; h39-40 is mission-reserved and not ready parking.
No direct PM counter values, general inactivity accrual law, other gap lengths, second PM cycle, GUI visual, cross-engine or overall Issue18 completion claim.
